---
title: "单台冷机 COP 快速体检表"
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    toc: false
mainfont: "Microsoft YaHei"
geometry: margin=2cm
params:
  input: "data/example_bms.csv"
  machine: "CH-01"
  rated_kw: 700
  low_cop: 3.5
  low_load: 0.30
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 3.3, dpi = 150)
if (!l10n_info()[["UTF-8"]]) {
  invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "English_United States.utf8"))
}
source("core.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
library(ggplot2)
result <- load_cop_data(params$input, params$machine, params$rated_kw,
                        params$low_cop, params$low_load)
x <- result$data
x$status <- factor(ifelse(x$attention, "低负荷且低 COP",
                   ifelse(x$low_efficiency, "低 COP", "正常")),
                   levels = c("正常", "低 COP", "低负荷且低 COP"))
palette <- c("正常" = "#2878a9", "低 COP" = "#e49c31",
             "低负荷且低 COP" = "#d94841")
```

**机组：** `r result$machine_id`　
**数据期间：** `r format(min(x$timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d")` 至 `r format(max(x$timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d")`　
**额定制冷量：** `r result$rated_kw` kW

```{r summary}
knitr::kable(cop_summary(result), col.names = c("指标", "结果"),
             align = c("l", "r"))
```

## COP 与负荷率

```{r load-scatter}
ggplot(x, aes(load_ratio * 100, cop, colour = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = result$low_cop, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#b94440") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = result$low_load * 100, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "#b94440") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "负荷率 (%)", y = "实时 COP", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Microsoft YaHei")
```

## COP 与室外温度

```{r outdoor-scatter}
ggplot(x, aes(outdoor_temp_c, cop, colour = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = result$low_cop, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#b94440") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "室外温度 (°C)", y = "实时 COP", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Microsoft YaHei")
```

## 快速判断

`r if (any(x$attention)) "有低负荷且低 COP 时段。建议先核对这些时段的运行时长、机组启停策略和冷冻水流量。" else if (any(x$low_efficiency)) "有低 COP 时段。建议结合负荷率与室外温度核对运行设定。" else "样本中未发现低于设定 COP 阈值的时段。"`

制冷量按 `r result$water_factor` × 流量（m³/h）× 冷冻水回供水温差（°C）计算；COP = 制冷量 / 功率。低效阈值为 COP < `r result$low_cop`，低负荷阈值为额定制冷量的 `r round(result$low_load * 100)`%。已剔除 `r result$excluded` 条缺值、停机或温差异常记录。结果仅用于快速筛查，阈值应结合机组性能曲线和现场工况设定。
